display_name: 四种域泛化：1/2/3/4/6源、监督/普通PL与固定标注预算三种子
description: 原432行矩阵；用户因已有五源实验取消后续五源工作，当前360次新增训练，仅1/2/3/4/6源，已完成五源产物保留历史。
authorization: 用户明确要求1、2、3、4、5、6源接收机全部设计并运行；排除独立ResNet18 CE；保留方法自身CE、三种子、原生预算、拼接星地增强、监督/普通PL。用户随后明确要求其他显卡也启动以加速：允许GPU0至7中的实际空闲卡，每卡一个本任务worker，不干预已有任务。

code.environment: existing N607 SDG-SEI Py3.8 torch1.11 + isolated NumPy1.23.5; no installation

data.version: new prefix source contracts validated once; existing received observations reused
data.validation_ref: builder data_status.json VALIDATED_ONCE; same target6 across every count
data.leo_config_ref: default LEO_WEAK source concat from first batch; clean+six practical testing

permissions.claim_scope: previously exposed WiSig proxy; one predetermined nested chain; no new blind/in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: scratch except 48 identical five-source frozen runs
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: reuse.parent_source exact contract/recipe; otherwise no initialization; IB stage2 same-run stage1 only
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: source roles checked before any inherited model use; other source counts train from scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: RIEI/DRIFT fixed final E100; SDG source-V minimum NLL within E200; IB two stages max E200 each, patience10

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0..7; one own worker/card; GPUs2/3 may share with one foreign compute process if >=12000MiB free; other cards require idle; preserve existing workers
execution.stop_rule: two identical technical row failures stop unstarted work; healthy active rows finish; no performance-based stopping

monitor.notify: meaningful changes, completion, failure, required input

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU score after all seven predictions fixed
